objective: Verify the S1 chain seam end-to-end against the fixed RingBuffer: own and run tests/test_audit_boundary.py covering (E1) happy-path chain via the API verifies anchored at GENESIS, (E2) frozen-contract regression — no audit field leaks into any C2 response and the 404 shape is unchanged, (E3) wrap boundary — capacity-3 buffer + 5 posts yields verify status 'unanchored_head' with head anchored=false and a head rewrite still detected as 'broken', (E4) mid-chain tamper — deleting a middle buffer slot yields 'broken' at the dangling link; then execute acceptance A1-A4 and record evidence. Observable outcome: all four boundary tests pass and the full suite (python -m unittest discover tests -v) is green.

concepts: wrap semantics: a capacity-N ring after N+2 appends holds exactly the newest N items (oldest-first via read_all())
frozen response discipline: no audit field may appear in any C2 response
structured verification statuses: 'ok' (anchored, links intact) / 'broken' (hash or link failure) / 'unanchored_head' (links intact but first item's prev != GENESIS)

inputs: integration-plan gates E1-E4 (scenario texts inlined in acceptance_tests below)

frozen_contracts.spec: Audit entry data stored inside each event item in the RingBuffer: the stored item is {id: 'e<n>', <event payload fields>, prev_entry_hash: str, entry_hash: str} where prev_entry_hash = entry_hash of the previously appended item (or GENESIS = sha256(b'genesis').hexdigest() for the first item ever appended) and entry_hash = sha256(canonical_json({id, prev_entry_hash})).hexdigest() with canonical_json = json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')). Chain order = RingBuffer storage order (oldest surviving first). The API layer never exposes prev_entry_hash/entry_hash outside the C3 query.

FROZEN, unchanged: POST /events -> 201 {'id': 'e<n>'}; GET /events?since=<id> -> 200 {'events': [...]} where each item has EXACTLY the keys the client posted plus 'id' (audit fields stripped at the API boundary — no prev_entry_hash/entry_hash in the response); unknown since id -> 404 {'error': 'unknown since id: <id>'}. Existing tests in tests/test_events.py stay green against this contract.

New: GET /events?audit=true -> 200 {'audit_chain': [{'event_id': str, 'prev_entry_hash': str, 'entry_hash': str}, ...]} in storage order (oldest surviving first); empty buffer -> 200 {'audit_chain': []}. This is the only API surface that exposes audit fields.

allowed_dependencies.what: app/audit.py — verify() + hashing (read; patch only via owns_fixes_for for seam defects)
app/events.py — EventAPI with chain append + audit query (read; patch only via owns_fixes_for for seam defects)

non_goals: No new production modules — this task owns a test file only
No weakening or modification of any pre-existing test (tests/test_events.py, tests/test_audit_core.py, tests/test_audit.py)
No seam fix that rewrites a leaf's module — integration-only minimal patches, or stop and record a blocker
implementation_constraints: tests are deterministic and in-memory: construct RingBuffer with small capacities directly; no network, no files, no sleeps
unittest style matching the repo suite; discoverable via python -m unittest discover tests -v
simulating tamper/truncation happens in-memory on the buffer's internal slot list after posting (test-level access to the fixture's internals is allowed and expected)

if a seam defect is found: minimal patch to the owning leaf's file (T01 or T02), re-run E1-E4, and record the deviation in the checkpoint; if the defect needs a leaf redesign, stop and record CORE_SEAM_BLOCKER instead of fixing it

deliverables.what: acceptance evidence A1-A4 (command + outcome) and any seam-fix deviations

acceptance_tests.description: E1: capacity-5 buffer, 3 posts via EventAPI; GET /events?audit=true returns exactly 3 entries in storage order; verify() over the presented items returns status 'ok', anchored at GENESIS, 0 broken links
acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest tests.test_audit_boundary.test_chain_e2e_ok -v → 1 test passes, exit code 0

acceptance_tests.description: E2: frozen-contract regression — after 2 posts, GET /events?since=<first id> returns 200 whose items have exactly the posted keys + 'id' with 'prev_entry_hash'/'entry_hash' absent; GET /events?since=unknown returns 404 {'error': 'unknown since id: unknown'} unchanged
acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest tests.test_audit_boundary.test_frozen_contract_unchanged -v → 1 test passes, exit code 0

acceptance_tests.description: E3: capacity-3 buffer, 5 posts (two overwrites); verify() over the 3 surviving entries returns status 'unanchored_head', head anchored=false, 0 broken links among survivors; then rewriting the head item's payload in memory makes verify() return status 'broken' (head rewrite still detected)
acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest tests.test_audit_boundary.test_wrap_unanchored_head tests.test_audit_boundary.test_wrap_head_rewrite_detected -v → 2 tests pass, exit code 0

acceptance_tests.description: E4: capacity-5 buffer, 3 posts; delete the middle stored item from the buffer's slot list (simulating truncation); verify() over the remaining items returns status 'broken' with first_broken_link at the dangling link
acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest tests.test_audit_boundary.test_mid_truncation_detected_e2e -v → 1 test passes, exit code 0

acceptance_tests.description: A4: the entire suite — pre-existing plus all new tests — exits 0 (all pass)
acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest discover tests -v → all tests pass, exit code 0

failure_cases.scenario: seam defect found (order mismatch, hash mismatch between T01/T02, audit field leaking into C2)
failure_cases.expected_behavior: minimal integration-only patch to the owning leaf file, re-run E1-E4, record the deviation in checkpoints/T03.json

failure_cases.scenario: defect requires redesigning a leaf (not an integration-only patch)
failure_cases.expected_behavior: stop; record CORE_SEAM_BLOCKER in checkpoints/T03.json; do not rewrite the leaf

failure_cases.scenario: pre-existing test starts failing after a seam fix
failure_cases.expected_behavior: revert the fix, record the conflict in the checkpoint — pre-existing tests are inviolable

handoff.notes: Final task of the stage (stage_boundary.stop_after = [T03]). The checkpoint must record: E1-E4 results, the full suite output (A4), acceptance evidence for A1-A4, and any seam fixes with their deviation notes. After this checkpoint the plan goes to the independent auditor — no further planning-stage work is expected from the executor.
